$comment: Documentation reference pack. It proposes no project kind and no executable lint tool.

markers.why: A documentation index proposes this pack; confirmation remains explicit.
Only a top-level Markdown-only tree without a build marker qualifies.

hostNote: any host; the repository supplies its own lint command
scaffoldNote: A single documentation lane; lint remains an explicit unsupported seat unless a command is supplied.
